mutations.name: p-last-resort-reason
mutations._mechanism: Replace the escaping exception's class name with Exception in the refusal token.

mutations.name: p-usage-token
mutations._mechanism: Let argparse exit directly on usage errors, bypassing the mode's refusal token.

mutations.name: p-unknown-mode-token
mutations._mechanism: Omit the cannot-judge token while preserving unknown-mode usage and exit 2.

mutations.name: p-no-help
mutations._mechanism: Restore argparse's help action, which exits 0 without the mode's token.

mutations.name: p-no-abbrev
mutations._mechanism: Accept --tre as --tree instead of reporting a UsageError refusal.

mutations.name: p-traceback-scope
mutations._mechanism: Print tracebacks for declared refusals as well as unexpected exceptions.

mutations.name: p-ledger-class-repeated
mutations._mechanism: Allow repeated per-document classes while aggregate totals remain unchanged.

mutations.name: p-ledger-class-moved
mutations._mechanism: Allow a class moved into the document required to omit it.

mutations.name: p-ledger-json
mutations._mechanism: Disable the JSON-object refusal.

mutations.name: p-ledger-field
mutations._mechanism: Disable required-field validation.

mutations.name: p-ledger-source
mutations._mechanism: Allow sources outside the phase documents.
mutations.find: if record["source"] not in documents:  # M:GAS-LEDGER-SOURCE

mutations.name: p-ledger-empty-original
mutations._mechanism: Allow an empty original through the ledger-counts check.

mutations.name: p-ledger-empty-expected
mutations._mechanism: Allow an empty expected finding.

mutations.name: p-origin
mutations._mechanism: Allow origins outside the imported vocabulary.
mutations.find: if record["origin"] not in ORIGINS:  # M:GAS-ORIGIN

mutations.name: p-rebuild-bytes
mutations._mechanism: Disable the byte-for-byte reconstruction comparison.

mutations.name: p-rebuild-original-once
mutations._mechanism: Allow a repeated original when one replacement matches the copy.

mutations.name: p-rebuild-section-twice
mutations._mechanism: Allow two seeds in the same heading section.

mutations.name: p-rebuild-version-history
mutations._mechanism: Allow a seed in Version History.
mutations.find: if parents and parents[-1].group(2).strip() == b"Version History":  # M:GAS-REBUILD-VERSION-HISTORY

mutations.name: p-rebuild-section-name
mutations._mechanism: Disable the exact containing-heading comparison.
mutations.find: if heading is None or heading.group(2).strip().decode("utf-8") != record["section"]:  # M:GAS-REBUILD-SECTION-NAME

mutations.name: p-rebuild-seeded-once
mutations._mechanism: Allow a seeded span appearing more than once.

mutations.name: p-refusal-reason
mutations._mechanism: Replace the declared refusal reason with its internal exception class.

mutations.name: p-leak-original
mutations._mechanism: Disable original-span matching.

mutations.name: p-leak-expected
mutations._mechanism: Disable expected-finding matching.

mutations.name: p-leak-normalise
mutations._mechanism: Decode without collapsing whitespace, hiding rewrapped needles.

mutations.name: p-leak-symlink-file
mutations._mechanism: Allow a symlink instead of refusing its root-relative path.

mutations.name: p-leak-symlink-dir
mutations._mechanism: Allow a symlink instead of refusing its root-relative path.

mutations.name: p-leak-exempt-sha-paired
mutations._mechanism: Exempt originals without checking paired-source identity and SHA.
mutations.find: exempt = (selected.get(relative) == record["source"] and digest == record.get("_source_sha256"))  # M:GAS-LEAK-EXEMPT-SHA

mutations.name: p-leak-exempt-sha-target
mutations._mechanism: Exempt originals without checking paired-source identity and SHA.
mutations.find: exempt = (selected.get(relative) == record["source"] and digest == record.get("_source_sha256"))  # M:GAS-LEAK-EXEMPT-SHA

mutations.name: p-leak-exempt-original-only
mutations._mechanism: Extend the paired-original exemption to expected findings.
mutations.replace: if not exempt: raise Refusal(f"leak:{relative}")  # M:GAS-LEAK-EXEMPT-ORIGINAL-ONLY

mutations.name: p-leak-tar
mutations._mechanism: Disable the tar data filter so an escaping member is accepted.

mutations.name: p-leak-list-grammar
mutations._mechanism: Accept an unknown exclusion kind.

mutations.name: p-reach-dotgit-dir
mutations._mechanism: Skip the nested .git entry refusal.

mutations.name: p-reach-dotgit-file
mutations._mechanism: Skip the nested .git entry refusal.

mutations.name: p-reach-revparse
mutations._mechanism: Ignore successful discovery of an ancestor Git repository.

mutations.name: p-parse-root
mutations._mechanism: Return incomplete ROOT records instead of rejecting missing fields.

mutations.name: p-reset-exclusive
mutations._mechanism: Skip the reset/dest-parent conflict before purpose and target validation.
mutations.find: if args.dest_parent is not None:  # M:GAS-RESET-EXCLUSIVE

mutations.name: p-reset-purpose
mutations._mechanism: Allow an S1 root to be reset under a non-S1 purpose.

mutations.name: p-reset-abs
mutations._mechanism: Skip the raw reset spelling's absolute-path check.

mutations.name: p-reset-isdir
mutations._mechanism: Skip the existing-directory check for a missing reset target.

mutations.name: p-reset-tmpdir
mutations._mechanism: Allow reset targets outside the resolved temporary directory's direct children.

mutations.name: p-reset-prefix
mutations._mechanism: Allow a different document's S1 root to pass target validation.

mutations.name: p-reset-reach
mutations._mechanism: Skip Git reach validation before anything can be removed from the target.

mutations.name: p-reset-rewalk
mutations._mechanism: Allow a post-restore path or file-hash mismatch.

mutations.name: p-reset-scan
mutations._mechanism: Skip step 6's content scan of the live root after restoration.

mutations.name: p-reset-step6-reach
mutations._mechanism: Skip step 6's Git reach check of the restored live root.

mutations.name: p-reset-nofollow-write
mutations._mechanism: Drop O_NOFOLLOW from the initial open, writing through the document link into its outside sentinel.
mutations.find: fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o666)  # M:GAS-RESET-NOFOLLOW-WRITE
mutations.replace: fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o666)  # M:GAS-RESET-NOFOLLOW-WRITE

mutations.name: p-reset-nofollow-remove
mutations._mechanism: Remove the symlink's resolved outside directory before unlinking it, deleting the outside sentinel without crashing.

mutations.name: p-reset-nofollow-parent
mutations._mechanism: Skip ancestor replacement, so a final-component-only O_NOFOLLOW open writes through the linked parent into its outside sentinel.

mutations.name: p-traceback-scope-reset
mutations._mechanism: Narrow declared traceback suppression to UsageError, exposing a traceback after the reset refusal token still matches.

mutations.name: p-record-root-line
mutations._mechanism: Disable the exactly-one ROOT READY line guard; duplicated lines then record successfully.

mutations.name: p-record-root-path
mutations._mechanism: Allow the recorded READY line to name a different root.

mutations.name: p-record-root-malformed
mutations._mechanism: Map a malformed READY line to path_mismatch instead of no_line without crashing.

mutations.name: p-record-auditcycle
mutations._mechanism: Record wrapper stdout that has no AUDITCYCLE token line.
mutations.find: if not any(line.startswith("AUDITCYCLE: ") for line in stdout_lines):  # M:GAS-RECORD-AUDITCYCLE

mutations.name: p-record-input
mutations._mechanism: Skip missing-input refusal so missing stdout reaches the no-AUDITCYCLE refusal instead.

mutations.name: p-record-stem-zero
mutations._mechanism: Allow a cycle with no matching wrapper stem to record its remaining data.

mutations.name: p-record-stem-two
mutations._mechanism: Accept two matching wrapper runs and silently select the first prefix.

mutations.name: p-record-command
mutations._mechanism: Skip required cycle flags so an absent cycle reaches stem-prefix refusal instead.

mutations.name: p-commit-parent
mutations._mechanism: Skip parent validation so Git plumbing refuses confirmation instead of parent_unknown.

mutations.name: p-commit-ref-moved
mutations._mechanism: Allow a moved calibration ref past the pre-write parent comparison.
mutations.find: if old and old != parent_oid:  # M:GAS-COMMIT-REF-MOVED

mutations.name: p-commit-outside
mutations._mechanism: Allow a source link resolving outside src to be committed and move the ref.

mutations.name: p-commit-reread
mutations._mechanism: Report success even when the post-update ref read disagrees with commit-tree.
mutations.find: if confirmed.returncode != 0 or confirmed.stdout.decode().strip() != new:  # M:GAS-COMMIT-REREAD

mutations.name: p-smoke-delivered-report-file
mutations._mechanism: Remove report-file from accepted delivery shapes.

mutations.name: p-smoke-delivered-out
mutations._mechanism: Remove out from accepted delivery shapes.

mutations.name: p-smoke-truncated
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke truncated guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-truncated-m3
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke truncated guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-vocab-split
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke vocab split guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-vocab-missing-end
mutations._mechanism: Suppress only the missing end vocabulary witness.
mutations.find: if kind not in types:  # M:GAS-SMOKE-VOCAB-MISSING
mutations.replace: if kind not in types and kind != "end":  # M:GAS-SMOKE-VOCAB-MISSING

mutations.name: p-smoke-vocab-missing-tool-call
mutations._mechanism: Suppress only the missing tool_call vocabulary witness.
mutations.find: if kind not in types:  # M:GAS-SMOKE-VOCAB-MISSING
mutations.replace: if kind not in types and kind != "tool_call":  # M:GAS-SMOKE-VOCAB-MISSING

mutations.name: p-smoke-vocab-missing-tool-call-update
mutations._mechanism: Suppress only the missing tool_call_update vocabulary witness.
mutations.find: if kind not in types:  # M:GAS-SMOKE-VOCAB-MISSING
mutations.replace: if kind not in types and kind != "tool_call_update":  # M:GAS-SMOKE-VOCAB-MISSING

mutations.name: p-smoke-no-delivery
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke no delivery guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-no-delivery-unscorable
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke no delivery guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-no-delivery-m4
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke no delivery guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-accepts-grok
mutations._mechanism: Suppress only grok root refusal.
mutations.replace: if not accepts[surface] and surface != "grok":  # M:GAS-SMOKE-ACCEPTS

mutations.name: p-smoke-accepts-agy
mutations._mechanism: Suppress only agy root refusal.
mutations.replace: if not accepts[surface] and surface != "agy":  # M:GAS-SMOKE-ACCEPTS

mutations.name: p-smoke-accepts-m5
mutations._mechanism: Suppress grok refusal despite the recorded UNVERIFIED authority.
mutations.replace: if not accepts[surface] and surface != "grok":  # M:GAS-SMOKE-ACCEPTS

mutations.name: p-smoke-missing-auditcycle
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke missing auditcycle guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-missing-collected
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke missing collected guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-unparseable-auditcycle
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke unparseable auditcycle guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-counts-unparseable
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke effort counts guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-counts-parsed
mutations._mechanism: Disable the smoke effort counts guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-codex-text
mutations._mechanism: Accept the codex-text item by bypassing its refusal inside the matched branch.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-missing
mutations._mechanism: Accept the missing-file item by bypassing its refusal inside the matched branch.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-empty
mutations._mechanism: Accept the empty-file item by bypassing its refusal inside the matched branch.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-unknown
mutations._mechanism: Accept an unrecognised item by bypassing the default refusal.

mutations.name: p-parse-auditcycle-one
mutations._mechanism: Disable the parse auditcycle one guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-parse-effort-item
mutations._mechanism: Disable the parse effort item guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-parse-effort-empty
mutations._mechanism: Disable the parse effort empty guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-parse-effort-twice
mutations._mechanism: Disable the parse effort twice guard while preserving the surrounding verdict path.

mutations.name: p-smoke-effort-malformed
